summary: Verified fix for /welcome/building Cloudflare 502 error + regression checks (desktop gate, mobile gate, OTP login, Timeline layout, nav). Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass — /api/connect/preview, /api/connect/establish, /api/connect/providers all return structured JSON (not Cloudflare HTML) and are reachable through external URL. Auth-required endpoints properly return JSON 4xx when unauthenticated. Frontend: OTP login flow works, DeviceGate correctly blocks mobile (414x820) with title 'Bracket is built for desktop' and does NOT block desktop (1366x768). Direct nav to /welcome/building correctly redirects to /welcome (needs router state). BuildingProject.jsx code review confirms retry loop (3 attempts, transient-only ~502/503/504/timeout/network, 1.5s*i backoff), friendlyError() replaces raw Cloudflare HTML with human copy, and the error state exposes data-testid='building-retry' (re-runs build via runBuild) and data-testid='building-goback' (navigate(-1)). critical_code_review_comments: BuildingProject.jsx runBuild retry logic is correct: isTransient() covers no-response, ECONNABORTED (axios timeout), and 502/503/504; loop retries up to 3 times only for transient, then throws for the outer catch to render friendlyError — no infinite loop, no retry on 4xx business errors. Good.
friendlyError only swaps copy for transient failures — non-transient errors still surface formatApiError(), which is appropriate.
DeviceGate: gate condition is (coarse pointer) OR (mobile UA) OR (width<768). Verified working at 1366x768 (no gate) and 414x820 (gate shown). Logic is sound.
Timeline scroll fix (.tl-scroll .conv-stream-region) is a CSS-only change and could not be validated with live data due to zero projects on the test account.

rca of the issue: Original bug: POST /api/connect/preview intermittently hit Cloudflare's 502 'origin returned invalid/incomplete response' during long LLM analysis, and the frontend rendered the raw HTML body as the error. Fix (verified in code + endpoint health test): (1) frontend auto-retries the preview+establish pair up to 3 times for transient failures with 1.5s * attempt backoff, so most single-request 502s self-heal; (2) friendlyError() masks raw HTML/gateway text with human copy; (3) error screen offers 'Try again' (in-place re-run) and 'Go back'. Origin is currently healthy — all 3 onboarding endpoints returned proper JSON on this iteration.
